title: Boolean loop host machine
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $B$ and $F$, a state $a$ of $B$, and a Boolean mode $m$, define a finite Boolean Turing machine with $B.k+1+(1+F.k)+1$ work tapes. Its initial state is the initial state of $F$. Its transition function combines a fuel phase and calls to the loop body, using additional tapes to track a flag, a counter, and a payload; depending on the mode and control phase, it emits Boolean symbols or halts.
caveat: The transition refers to auxiliary state and action definitions whose meanings are not included in the supplied definitions, so their precise behavior cannot be stated self-containedly from this payload.
